CustomField.description: Lot size in acres. The LLM reports whichever unit (acres or square feet) the email actually states; when only square feet is stated, Apex converts to acres (divided by 43,560) rather than the model guessing. Canonical unit = acres, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by LLM extraction from the inbound broker email; null when not stated in the email.
CustomField.label: Lot Size (Acres)
